title: The Temple at Senntisten
start: Talk to Ali the Wise at his house in Nardah.

items.t: Telekinetic Grab runes (one air and law rune for each cast; you must be on the standard spellbook)

recommended.t: 3 Barrows amulets (to skip 3 of the brothers if you don't want to fight all 6)
Coins (and optionally Ring of charos (a)) for carpet ride
Archaeology journal to teleport to Exam Centre

Drakan's medallion to reach the Barrows faster. Alternatively, you can use the ectophial or the Canifis lodestone and travel through Mort Myre Swamp (the Nature Spirit quest is required for this). If a portal in War's Retreat is attuned to the Barrows, this may also be used.
Silverlight or darklight to slay the ice demon

kills.t: The six Barrows brothers (up to three may be skipped with barrows amulets):

rewards.t: 23000 Skill XP lamp for any chosen skill (level 50+)
Two 20000 Combat XP lamps for any chosen combat skill (level 50+)
Access to a new set of prayers, known as the Ancient Curses. You must read the Ancient hymnal, given to you by Azzanadra, in order to activate them.
Access to the Altar of Zaros in the Senntisten Temple, located below the Varrock Dig Site. Praying at this altar boosts your prayer points to 15% over your current maximum level.
Access to Ghorrock - an inhospitable and dangerous fortress to reach, but where iron and steel dragons, waterfiends, and icefiends can be found.
Items obtained from the Barrows Chest

steps.t: Talk to Ali the Wise in the northernmost building in Nardah. [Chat: 1 How goes the research? › 1 Well, I certainly don't like those of the Zamorakian faction. › 1 Zaros seems to be an honourable god. › Accept › 2 Can you help me get to the Digsite Exam Centre?]
Go to the Exam Centre.

sub.t: If you asked Ali for help getting there, he gave you a Dig Site pendant (or Ali's pendant if you have not unlocked the ability to create Dig Site pendants) to teleport directly there.
Alternatively, teleporting to Varrock Dig Site with either pendant for the first time will grant you the Return to Senntisten achievement.

steps.t: Talk to Dr. Nabanik outside of the Exam Centre south of the Digsite. [Chat: 1 (Whisper) Why are we speaking so quietly? › 1 Azzanadra? You are quite the master of disguise. › 1 Why are you here, away from the pyramid? › 2 What's Ali's part in this? › 3 Why all the secrecy? › 4 Just tell me what you want.]

Talk to Terry Balando inside the exam centre for a restoration certificate. [Chat: 1 I'm here about a close friend of mine: Dr Nabanik. › 1 He was in the pyramid for a very long time. › 1 I've seen those beetles and they're huge. › 1 He studies pyramids, particularly their interiors. › 1 He has an aged benefactor.]
p: Dr Nabanik managing the temple restoration

steps.t: Talk to Dr. Nabanik. He will give you a rope.
Use the rope on the winch in the north-east dig site, north of The Stormbreaker ship.
Operate the winch to enter the Digsite dungeon.

Talk to Azzanadra in the southern part of the dungeon. [Chat: 1 I'd like to talk about the temple. › 1 Is there anything I can do to help? › 1 Okay, what do I need to do? › 2 Tell me about the mission in the north. › Any]
Open the ruined backpack for a battered letter and heat globe.

Read the letter and then talk to Azzanadra. [Chat: 1 I'd like to talk about the temple. › 1 Tell me about the mission in Morytania. › 1 I have some questions about the mission in Morytania. › 2 Do you have any advice for me? › 3 Let's talk about something else. › 4 Tell me about the artefacts you need. › 1 Tell me about the fortress artefact. › 2 Tell me about the Barrows artefact. › 4 Never mind.]
Travel to the Barrows.
Kill the six Barrows Brothers found in their tombs below the ground.

sub.t: Barrows amulets can be used to skip killing up to three brothers.
Amulets can only be used on the tombs before the brother is summoned.
The final brother must be killed without using an amulet.

p: Fighting a Barrows Brother in the tunnels

steps.t: Once all six brothers are dead, search the chest at the centre of the tunnels beneath the crypts to get the Barrows icon.
Go to the Ghorrock fortress:

sub.t: First use the canoe near Erjolf from Tale of the Muspah for a quick access. It is located on the west coast of the Rellekka Hunter area, north of fairy ring code DKS.
Go east and place the heat globe on the pedestal near the ice block entrance.

p: The safer western entrance to Ghorrock
The southern face of Ghorrock Fortress
A map of Ghorrock, the frozen fortress.

steps.t: Enter the fortress through the south entrance and climb-up the stairs to the west.
Run to the south-east corner of the castle and climb-down the stairs east.
Scale up the damaged wall north of the door.
Climb down the smashed rampart in the north-west corner.
Enter the trapdoor in front of you.
Run east and take the heat globe.
Return to the entrance room of the basement, and place the heat globe on the pedestal on the west side.

sub.t: A waterfiend will be released. It is immune to fire damage, but does not need to be killed.

steps.t: Go inside the west room, then right-click the radiant pedestal to cast Telekinetic Grab on it.
p: Pushing the heat globe down the slope

steps.t: Use the globe on this room's pedestal. Go down the trapdoor.

sub.t: A waterfiend will be released. It is immune to fire damage, but does not need to be killed.

steps.t: Pick up the globe in the southern room.
Use it on the pedestal back in the northern room with the ladder. 2 waterfiends will spawn.
Loot the crates in the south room for 40 law runes and 300 air runes.
Go to the east room and take the globe from the pedestal for an imperfect heat globe.
Exit the dungeon the way you entered.
Scale the damaged wall to the west, then head to the north-east corner to the destroyed pedestal.
Insert-globe in the smashed globe-holder on the ground.
Choose the push option on the smashed globe-holder on the ground.
After a cutscene, climb down the smashed rampart in the north-west corner.
Return to the dungeon by re-entering the trapdoor. [Chat: 1 Yes, carry on from where I was.]
Go down the trapdoor in the western room.
Run through the dungeon and take the heat globe from the pedestal in the southwestern corner.
Head back east through the hallway you ran through until you reach the southeast corner, where the path turns north.
p: A player fighting the ice demon.

steps.t: At that corner, look for a pipe on the south wall.
Choose the "Place-globe" option on the pipe.
Choose the "Whack" option on the pipe.
Continue into the southeastern room and climb the ladder to go up.
Head west and kill the ice demon (it cannot be damaged by water spells).
Take the Frostenhorn that it drops.

Return to Azzanadra with the items back at the Senntisten Temple underneath the Dig Site. [Chat: 1 I'd like to talk about the temple. › 1 I have something here for you. › 1 What does the Frosthorn do? › 1 Okay, what do I need to obtain next?]

sub.t: The Dig Site pendant can be used to teleport outside the temple (option 2).

steps.t: Back outside near the winch, talk to the Assassin for a relic. [Chat: 1 Mask or no mask, I remember you. › Any › Any › Any]
p: Azzanadra praying for Zaros to return

steps.t: Return to Azzanadra. [Chat: 1 I'd like to talk about the temple. › 5 Anyway, what now? › 2 I'm not interested, I just want a reward › 3 Boring! Get on with it!]
After the cutscene, speak to Azzanadra again. [Chat: 1 I'm glad I could help. › Any]
Quest complete!
p: The Dig Site workmen receive some power. Something's happening...
A statue of Zamorak is destroyed invoking the anger of Zamorakian monks against Saradomin
